title_en: The Building That Melted a Car
english_paragraphs: On 2 September 2013 the news broke that a London skyscraper under construction had damaged a Jaguar. Martin Lindsay had left the saloon by the pavement on Eastcheap, opposite the tower's frontage. He returned to find its wing mirror warped, its panels deformed and its badge distorted. The glazed facade above was to blame.

Rafael Viñoly curved the south face of 20 Fenchurch Street inward, enlarging the upper storeys, where tenants pay a premium. That geometry acted like a magnifying glass, focusing sunlight into a beam up to six times brighter than direct sun. It was measured at about 110 degrees Celsius, and a reporter fried an egg in a pan using the reflection.

The developers issued an apology and reimbursed almost 1,000 pounds for repairs. Parking bays were suspended and a provisional barrier was erected. The beam struck for about two hours a day, two to three weeks annually, because of the sun's angle of elevation. Newspapers dubbed the Walkie-Talkie the Walkie-Scorchie, a taunt.

The architect was candid, admitting many mistakes. Viñoly had anticipated the focusing, he said, but not its intensity. Sun louvres in the original design were reportedly removed in cost-cutting. Nor was this his first architectural miscalculation. In 2010 the infamous glare from his curved, reflective Vdara hotel in Las Vegas burned a guest's scalp by the pool.

On 12 February 2014 a permanent fixture was announced: horizontal aluminium fins to diffuse the brightness, reportedly costing several million pounds. In September 2015 Building Design's critics gave the notorious tower the Carbuncle Cup, a trophy for the UK's worst new building. The ballot was unanimous.
chinese_source_paragraphs: 2013年9月2日，一则新闻传开，说伦敦一座**正在建设中的**(under construction)**摩天大楼**(skyscraper)损坏了一辆捷豹车。马丁·林赛把这辆**轿车**(saloon)停在伊斯特奇普街的**人行道**(pavement)旁边，正对着这座高楼的**正面**(frontage)。他回来时发现，车的后视镜已经**翘曲**(warped)，车身板**变形**(deformed)，并且**车标**(badge)也**扭曲了**(distorted)。上方那面**镶玻璃的**(glazed)**正面墙**(facade)是罪魁祸首。

拉斐尔·维诺利（在设计中）将芬丘奇街20号的南立面向内弯曲，**扩大了**(enlarging)上部**楼层**(storeys)，那里的**租户**(tenants)支付着**溢价**(premium)（更高的租金）。这种**几何形状**(geometry)就像一面**放大**(magnifying)镜，把**阳光**(sunlight)汇聚成一道**光束**(beam)，亮度可达直射阳光的六倍。测得的温度约为110摄氏度，一名**记者**(reporter)还在**平底锅**(pan)里利用**反射光**(reflection)煎熟了一个鸡蛋。

**开发商**(developers)作出了**道歉**(apology)，并**赔付了**(reimbursed)近1,000英镑的修理费。路边停车位**暂停使用**(suspended)，并且一道**临时的**(provisional)**屏障**(barrier)被**搭建了起来**(erected)。这道光束**每年**(annually)会照射两到三周、每天约照射两小时，因为这是太阳的**仰角**(angle of elevation)。报纸把对讲机大楼戏称为“烤焦机大楼”，这是一句**嘲讽**(taunt)。

这位**建筑师**(architect)很**坦率**(candid)，承认犯了很多错误。维诺利说，他**预料到了**(anticipated)外墙会聚光，却没想到聚光的**强度**(intensity)会这么大。据报道，原设计中的**遮阳百叶**(Sun louvres)在**削减成本**(cost-cutting)时被删掉了。这也不是他第一次出现**建筑上的**(architectural)**失算**(miscalculation)。2010年，他那座位于拉斯维加斯、弯曲**反光的**(reflective)维达拉酒店反射出**臭名昭著的**(infamous)**强光**(glare)，在泳池边灼伤了一位客人的**头皮**(scalp)。

2014年2月12日，一项**永久性的**(permanent)**固定装置**(fixture)方案公布，那就是在外墙加装**水平的**(horizontal)**铝制**(aluminium)散光**鳍片**(fins)，来**散射**(diffuse)光线、减弱**亮度**(brightness)，据报道花费达数百万英镑。2015年9月，《建筑设计》杂志的**评论家**(critics)们将“烂疮杯”颁给了这座**声名狼藉的/臭名远扬的**(notorious)大楼，这是一个专门颁给英国最糟糕新建筑的**奖杯**(trophy)。这次**投票**(ballot)**全体一致**(unanimous)。

sentences.chinese_source: 维诺利说，他**预料到了**(anticipated)外墙会聚光，却没想到聚光的**强度**(intensity)会这么大。

sentences.english: Sun louvres in the original design were reportedly removed in cost-cutting.
sentences.chinese_source: 据报道，原设计中的**遮阳百叶**(Sun louvres)在**削减成本**(cost-cutting)时被删掉了。

sentences.english: Nor was this his first architectural miscalculation.
sentences.chinese_source: 这也不是他第一次出现**建筑上的**(architectural)**失算**(miscalculation)。

sentences.english: In 2010 the infamous glare from his curved, reflective Vdara hotel in Las Vegas burned a guest's scalp by the pool.
sentences.chinese_source: 2010年，他那座位于拉斯维加斯、弯曲**反光的**(reflective)维达拉酒店反射出**臭名昭著的**(infamous)**强光**(glare)，在泳池边灼伤了一位客人的**头皮**(scalp)。

sentences.english: On 12 February 2014 a permanent fixture was announced: horizontal aluminium fins to diffuse the brightness, reportedly costing several million pounds.
sentences.chinese_source: 2014年2月12日，一项**永久性的**(permanent)**固定装置**(fixture)方案公布，那就是在外墙加装**水平的**(horizontal)**铝制**(aluminium)散光**鳍片**(fins)，来**散射**(diffuse)光线、减弱**亮度**(brightness)，据报道花费达数百万英镑。

sentences.english: In September 2015 Building Design's critics gave the notorious tower the Carbuncle Cup, a trophy for the UK's worst new building.
sentences.chinese_source: 2015年9月，《建筑设计》杂志的**评论家**(critics)们将“烂疮杯”颁给了这座**声名狼藉的/臭名远扬的**(notorious)大楼，这是一个专门颁给英国最糟糕新建筑的**奖杯**(trophy)。

approved_summary: 2013年，伦敦对讲机大楼反射的阳光，使路边捷豹车的后视镜、车身和车标变形。
内凹的玻璃南立面扩大了高租金的上层面积，也聚集阳光；光束亮度最高为直射光六倍，受照处约110℃。
开发商赔偿近千英镑并停用车位、设置屏障；因太阳角度，强光每年出现两三周，每天约两小时。
建筑师承认低估强度；遮阳百叶据报因省钱被删；他设计的另一酒店，2010年就曾反光伤人。
2014年公布加装横向铝片、分散反光的方案，据报需数百万英镑；2015年获英国最差新建筑奖。
